The issue is in `cache.py`. The `get` method uses `now > entry.expires_at` to check for expiration. This means that if `now == expires_at`, the token is considered valid (not expired). The ticket states that "Stale bearer tokens remained valid at the exact expiration second". The correct behavior should be that a token is expired when `current_time >= expires_at` (as defined in `CachedToken.is_expired_at`).

I will change the condition in `cache.py` from `now > entry.expires_at` to `now >= entry.expires_at`.
